solution.one_line_summary: Guard against a missing user in `sendWelcomeEmail` by returning early when `getUser` returns `null`.

steps.title: Add a null check
steps.description: In `notifications.js`, check whether `user` is defined after calling `getUser(userId)` and return early if it is not.

steps.title: Log the missing user
steps.description: Emit a warning when no user is found so the missing record can be investigated.
